lines.en: label norikospring1:
scene nightsky
Somehow or another, I wind up in the second half of town again.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我又逛到了镇子的另一半。

lines.en: But seeing as I’ve learned my lesson (be it conscious or not) to try and stay away from bridges or overhangs or anything else I can throw myself off of, I now have to figure out something else to do.
lines.zh: 不过既然我已经吸取了教训（不管是有意识还是无意识的）——要尽量远离桥梁、天台或者任何能让我跳下去的地方，那我现在就得想点别的事做。

lines.en: But do you know what place doesn’t have any bridges or overhangs? The convenience store.
lines.zh: 可你知道什么地方既没有桥也没有天台吗？便利店。

lines.en: Unfortunately, there’s a creature with pink hair who practically lives inside of that building that is equally dangerous to me based on nothing but several blackouts and the biases of my deceased girlfriend(?).
lines.zh: 不幸的是，那栋楼里住着一个粉头发的生物，她几乎就长在里面，而她对我的危险程度也不相上下——虽然这判断的依据，不过是几次断片，以及我那位已故女友（？）的偏见。

lines.en: And no, I’m obviously not saying that because the creature in question lives her life with a pocketknife tucked into her waistband. I am saying it because it’s true.
lines.zh: 而且不，我这么说显然不是因为那个生物腰带上别着一把折叠刀过日子。我这么说，是因为这是事实。

lines.en: scene black
While the pieces of my past may no longer throw this puzzle of a life into potential world-ending turmoil, it doesn’t mean I’m ready to start filling in the blanks.
lines.zh: 尽管我过去的那些碎片，也许再也不会把我这拼图般的人生搅进足以毁灭世界的动荡里，但这不代表我已经准备好去填补那些空白了。

lines.en: And something that’s a happy memory for her might be a nightmare for me. Which is why I have to be careful.
lines.zh: 而对我来说，某件对她而言是幸福回忆的事，也许就是一场噩梦。所以我必须小心。

lines.en: I {i}can{/i} learn.
lines.zh: 我{i}可以{/i}去学。

lines.en: I just don’t want to.
lines.zh: 我只是不想学。

lines.en: : Ah! Onii-chan!
lines.zh: : 啊！Onii-chan！

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire1
: {i}Onii-chan?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Onii-chan？{/i}

lines.en: : Not legally or biologically, but somewhat historically. And history dictates that it’s normal for me to call him that while we’re in here!
lines.zh: : 法律上和血缘上都不是，但历史上算。而历史决定了，我们在这店里的时候，我这么叫他是很正常的！

lines.en: : Just because you have a history of doing that doesn’t make it “normal.”
lines.zh: : 你有那样做的历史，并不能让它变得「正常」。

lines.en: : Yeah, it makes it fuckin’ weird and gross.
lines.zh: : 对，那只让它变得他妈的又怪又恶心。

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t think I’d go {i}that{/i} far.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我觉得没到{i}那个{/i}地步吧。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire2
: Shocker.
lines.zh: : 真让人意外。

lines.en: : You’re welcome to call me a cute pet-name as well if you’d like, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你也可以给我起个可爱的昵称，如果你愿意的话，Yumi。

lines.en: : Sure. Does Captain Rapist work for you or should I figure something else out?
lines.zh: : 行啊。「强奸队长」你觉得怎么样，还是我再想一个别的？

lines.en: : Figure something else out, please.
lines.zh: : 麻烦你再想一个。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire3
: Nicknames aside- you got here at the perfect time, Sensei! I was just about to go on break.
lines.zh: : 昵称的事先放一边——你来得正是时候，老师！我正准备去休息呢。

lines.en: : That’s nice. But Yumi has a track record of shoplifting and probably shouldn’t be left here alone.
lines.zh: : 那挺好的。不过 Yumi 有偷东西的前科，大概不该把她一个人留在这儿。

lines.en: : He ain’t wrong.
lines.zh: : 他说得没毛病。

lines.en: : Yumi’s fine. She needs money way more than candy and condoms.
lines.zh: : Yumi 没问题的。比起糖和避孕套，她更需要的是钱。

lines.en: : But you and me? We’ve got other stuff to do. Primarily stuff of the “bonding” variety since you now treat me like the middle child and don’t let me love you as much as you used to.
lines.zh: : 但你和我？我们有别的事要做。主要是「联络感情」那一类的，因为你现在把我当中间那个孩子看，都不让我像以前那样爱你了。

lines.en: : So is he your {i}brother{/i} or your dad? I don’t get this relationship.
lines.zh: : 那他到底是你{i}哥{/i}还是你爸？我搞不懂你们这关系。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire4
: Brother in the streets, daddy in the sheets.
lines.zh: : 在外是哥哥，上床是爸爸。

lines.en: : How do I put in my two-weeks notice? I’ve never done it before.
lines.zh: : 我该怎么提交两周的辞呈？我从没做过这种事。

lines.en: : You don’t. You’re stuck here forever.
lines.zh: : 你不用。你永远都得困在这儿。

lines.en: : In more ways than you know.
lines.zh: : 而且困的程度，比你想象的还要深。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire5
: Which means that you and I are {i}free!{/i}
lines.zh: : 也就是说，你和我{i}自由{/i}啦！

lines.en: : From your shift? Sure. From the never-ending cycle of misery that blankets this school year in doubt and misfortune like snow over the Arctic plains? Nope. No one is free from that.
lines.zh: : 从你的班？那当然。可要说从那场像北极荒原上的雪一样、把整个学年都盖在怀疑与不幸之下的无休止的痛苦循环里？不行。没人能从那里头获得自由。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire6
: But you don’t even go to school anymore. Which means you should be more concerned with taking that blanket off of me so we don’t have to conceal our cuddling from anyone we know.
lines.zh: : 可你都已经不去学校了啊。那你就更应该操心怎么把那层毯子从我身上掀开，这样我们就不用在认识的人面前偷偷摸摸地抱在一起了。

lines.en: : Hey, before you clock out for break, do you mind if I run to the bathroom and make myself puke really quick?
lines.zh: : 嘿，在你打卡去休息之前，介不介意我先冲进洗手间，快速把自己催吐一下？

lines.en: scene black

: I do, actually. Purging isn’t good for your teeth. Or really anything for that matter. So keep all of that stuff inside you while {i}we{/i} get out of your hair! Which looks very beautiful, by the way. Which shampoo do you use?
lines.zh: : 我确实介意。催吐对牙齿不好。说实话对什么都不好。所以趁{i}我们{/i}赶紧从你眼前消失，把那些东西都留在肚子里吧！顺便说一句，你的头发看起来很漂亮。你用的是哪种洗发水？

lines.en: : Uhh...I ain’t sure. But I hope we’re havin’ another one of those fuckin’ hotel parties soon because I’m running low on whatever it is.
lines.zh: : 呃……我不太确定。但我希望我们很快能再开一次那种他妈的酒店派对，因为我那玩意儿快用完了。

lines.en: : Are you just...using the sample bottles from the hotels?...
lines.zh: : 你该不会……一直在用酒店里那些小样瓶吧？……

lines.en: : Beats payin’ for shit, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 总比花钱买强吧，不是吗？

lines.en: : Some may call her cheap. {i}I{/i} call her resourceful.
lines.zh: : 有人会说她小气。{i}我{/i}管这叫会过日子。

lines.en: : She’ll look gorgeous as my maid of honor on our wedding day. And save me so much money as well.
lines.zh: : 她在我们婚礼上当伴娘一定美极了。而且还能帮我省下好多钱。

lines.en: : {i}Blch!...{/i}Sorry...I’ll be right back!
lines.zh: : {i}呕哇{/i}！……抱歉……我马上回来！

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire7

After Yumi disobeys Noriko’s orders and regurgitates the evidence of her disgust for me into the convenience store bathroom, I grab a beer and head outside with that pink-haired creature I warned you about before.
lines.zh: 在 Yumi 违抗了 Noriko 的命令、把对我厌恶的证据吐进便利店洗手间之后，我拿了一罐啤酒，和我先前警告过你的那个粉头发生物一起走了出去。

lines.en: Her smile stings like antiseptic and the glow of her skin near the fire reminds me less of a certain type of bug and more of a vending machine. But I think that part is kind of beautiful in its own way.
lines.zh: 她的笑容像消毒剂一样刺人，而她靠近火光时皮肤泛出的光泽，让我想起的与其说是某种虫子，不如说是一台自动售货机。但我觉得那部分自有它独特的美。

lines.en: She never leaves because she can’t. And she’ll give me anything I want so long as I press the right button.
lines.zh: 她从不离开，因为她离不开。而只要我按对了按钮，她就会给我任何我想要的东西。

lines.en: When she looks at me, I instinctively look away. I’m not sure if it’s because I’m embarrassed or not when I don’t have anything specific to be embarrassed {i}about,{/i} but it certainly feels that way.
lines.zh: 她看我的时候，我会本能地移开视线。我不确定这是不是因为害羞——我并没有什么具体该害羞的事——但感觉上确实就是那样。

lines.en: I take a sip of my drink, hoping its effects take root long before they’re supposed to because maybe that will be the push I need to stare back at her while her eyes beg for the attention of mine.
lines.zh: 我抿了一口酒，希望它的效力能比该有的时候早得多地发作，因为也许那正是我需要的推力，好让我能在她的眼睛乞求我注视的时候回望过去。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire8
But instead, we sit in silence.
lines.zh: 但相反，我们只是沉默地坐着。

lines.en: Her excitement, like that of a loyal dog, has waned now that I’ve gotten settled in. It was only the initial shock that caused her tail to wag.
lines.zh: 她的兴奋——像一只忠犬那样——在我安顿下来之后就消退了。只是最初的冲击才让她的尾巴摇了起来。

lines.en: I’m sure she’s thinking of what we’re supposed to talk about now. And I hate that she has to do that — but it’s the result of {i}me{/i} being a terrible owner.
lines.zh: 我敢说她正在想，我们现在该聊些什么。而我讨厌她不得不这么做——但那都是因为{i}我{/i}这个主人当得太糟糕。

lines.en: You see, “settling in” for me is more like taking my clothes off and pulling my knees to my chest in the corner of the room. {i}Of course{/i} a dog’s excitement would fade if it had to watch such a thing.
lines.zh: 你要知道，对我来说「安顿下来」更像是脱掉衣服、把膝盖抱到胸前，缩在房间的角落里。一只狗要是得看着这种场面，兴奋劲儿{i}当然{/i}会消退。

lines.en: But she’ll figure out what to do and what I need soon enough because {i}she’s{/i} the mature one here.
lines.zh: 但她很快就会想明白该做什么、我需要什么，因为在这段关系里，成熟的那个人是{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: See?
lines.zh: 看吧？

lines.en: She’s already coming over to lick me.
lines.zh: 她已经开始过来舔我了。

lines.en: : So I heard from Nee-chan about her possibly moving in?
lines.zh: : 我从姐那儿听说，她可能会搬进来住？

lines.en: : Well, keep it to yourself because Ami hasn’t yet.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，你自己知道就好，因为 Ami 还没说。

lines.en: : So it’s true then?
lines.zh: : 那就是真的了？

lines.en: : Maybe. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。我不知道。

lines.en: : I’m trying to step up and play the role of a father, but there’s no denying that a mother would probably be better for Ami. And I think Niki fits that role better than anyone.
lines.zh: : 我在努力担起父亲这个角色，但不可否认，对 Ami 来说，母亲大概会更好。而我觉得 Niki 比任何人都更适合那个位置。

lines.en: : Yeah. Guess it wouldn’t make much sense for {i}me{/i} to be Ami’s mother figure when we’re almost the same age.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我们年纪本来就差不多，让{i}我{/i}来当 Ami 的母亲角色，确实说不通。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire9
: Can you imagine? Me telling her to clean her room and do the dishes and stuff like that?
lines.zh: : 你能想象吗？我让她去打扫房间、洗碗之类的？

lines.en: : No, but that’s mostly because she already does all of those things without asking.
lines.zh: : 不能，不过主要是因为她根本不用人说，那些事就全做了。

lines.en: : Then what would I need to do? Hit me with the job description, Sensei. Maybe I’ll throw my hat in the ring and compete with Nee-chan only to lose for the millionth time?
lines.zh: : 那我需要做什么？把岗位说明书扔给我吧，老师。也许我该加入战局，跟姐竞争一番，然后再输掉第一百万次？

lines.en: : Would you even {i}want{/i} a role like that in the first place? You’re young. I thought you still wanted to {i}figure out who you are{/i} and all that?
lines.zh: : 你一开始真的{i}想要{/i}那样的角色吗？你还年轻。我以为你还想{i}弄清自己是谁{/i}之类的？

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire10
: I’m just messing around. As nice as it sounds to have you as my partner in life, I can’t imagine ever seeing Ami as a daughter.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的。虽然能把你当作人生伴侣听起来很美好，但我无法想象自己会把 Ami 看成女儿。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire11
: So I guess maybe I really {i}am{/i} screwed if that’s going to be part of the criteria now.
lines.zh: : 那这么看来，如果这也要算进条件里，我大概{i}是{/i}真的没戏了。

lines.en: : Oh well. It was a good run. All that’s left to do now is wait for gay marriage to be legalized so I can marry Kirin and open a sex shop or something.
lines.zh: : 唉，算了。这一程也算精彩。现在剩下能做的，就是等同性婚姻合法化，然后我好跟 Kirin 结婚，开家情趣用品店什么的。

lines.en: : You’ve got some strong competition in town, Noriko. Don’t think that path will be easy. Maybe take over your parents’ restaurant instead?
lines.zh: : 你在镇上可是有强劲的竞争对手的，Noriko。别以为那条路会好走。要不干脆接手你爸妈的餐馆？

lines.en: : Kirin {i}would{/i} look hot in a qipao. But again, this is all just fantasy-talk and not a thing I’m actually considering. Which I need to verbally clarify so you don’t misunderstand and think I’m actually quitting you.
lines.zh: : Kirin 穿旗袍一定很辣。不过再说一次，这些都只是幻想闲聊，不是我真的在考虑的事。我得口头澄清一下，免得你误{i}会{/i}，以为我真的要把你甩了。

lines.en: : I never figured you were in the first place. I’m not sure what you’d even do with yourself if you weren’t too busy chasing after me all the time.
lines.zh: : 我从一开始就没觉得你会。我真不知道，如果你不是整天忙着追我，你还会拿自己怎么办。

lines.en: : Like I said, just making sure. We don’t need to dwell on the fact that I’m a wannabe brocon any longer than we already have.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，只是确认一下。我们没必要在我这个冒牌兄控这件事上纠缠太久，已经够久了。

lines.en: : Especially when there’s something I actually {i}want{/i} to talk about tonight.
lines.zh: : 尤其是今晚我还有一件真正{i}想{/i}谈的事。

lines.en: : Oh good. Late night talks always go really well for me.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。深夜谈话对我来说一向都很顺利呢。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire12
if amifingered == True:
: You’re one to talk. Because I distinctly remember one of our last late-night talks ending with you telling me that I had to “suffer for you.”
lines.zh: : 你也好意思说。因为我清楚地记得，我们上一次深夜谈话里，最后你说我必须「为你受苦」。

lines.en: : And you’ve been doing a great job.
lines.zh: : 而你一直做得很好。

lines.en: : Have I? It doesn’t feel like it.
lines.zh: : 有吗？我感觉不像。

lines.en: : That’s how you know you’re doing it well.
lines.zh: : 那正说明你做得好。

lines.en: else:
: I guess our track record isn’t great when it comes to those, is it?
lines.zh: : 看来我们在那方面的记录不怎么样，是吧？

lines.en: : My track record in general isn’t great when it comes to those. But it’s not great when it comes to daytime conversations either, so I’m not sure what I’m expecting.
lines.zh: : 我在这方面的记录本来就不怎么样。可白天的对话同样不怎么样，所以我也不知道自己到底在期待什么。

lines.en: : This one might be a little awkward, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这次可能会有点尴尬，老师。

lines.en: : Well, that’s a great thing to hear right before I find out what it is.
lines.zh: : 在我知道内容之前先听到这句，可真是太好了。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: If I’m going to suffer for you...would you mind suffering for me for a little while? Even if it’s just tonight.
lines.zh: : 既然我要为你受苦……那你愿不愿意也为我受一会儿苦？哪怕只有今晚。

lines.en: else:
: My timing has never been good. Now’s no exception to that.
lines.zh: : 我的时机从来就没好过。这次也不例外。

lines.en: : What is it then, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么事，Noriko？

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire13
: We had the Dorm Wars again recently.
lines.zh: : 我们最近又办了一次宿舍大战。

lines.en: : It was a lot of fun...But it felt really different without you. Just like class has felt different with Imani as our teacher and...the dorms without whispers of who you’re with and when.
lines.zh: : 那很有趣……但没有你在，感觉真的不一样。就像换了 Imani 当老师之后，课也变得不一样了……还有宿舍里，再也没人窃窃私语你跟谁在一起、什么时候。

lines.en: : There’s a lot that feels like that now. Like this is a...slightly incorrect world that we accidentally fell into when you and Ami left school.
lines.zh: : 现在有很多事都给人这种感觉。就好像……在你和 Ami 离开学校之后，我们不小心掉进了一个略微出错的世界。

lines.en: : And I don’t know if I’m the only one who’s noticed or...if everyone is just trying to save face...but sometimes, it feels like a lot of the smaller details go unnoticed by everyone but me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道是不是只有我注意到了……或者大家只是在死撑场面……但有时候，我觉得很多细枝末节，除了我以外谁都看不见。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s just the type of person I am — someone who looks a little too closely at everything, but...
lines.zh: : 也许我本来就是那种人——看什么都看得太仔细的人，可是……

lines.en: : See, that’s kind of what I wanted to talk to you about in the first place. To see if maybe I’m just going crazy or...if you’ve noticed something too.
lines.zh: : 你看，这其实才是我一开始想跟你谈的事。想看看是不是只有我疯了……或者你也注意到了什么。

lines.en: : Well...what are you talking about, exactly?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你具体在说什么？

lines.en: : I’m talking about Maya.
lines.zh: : 我在说 Maya。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire14
: Come on...don’t look at me like that. You make me talk about stuff {i}I’m{/i} not 100%% comfortable with all the time. Can’t you bear with me for a second just to hear me out?
lines.zh: : 拜托……别那样看我。你一直都在逼我谈论那些{i}我{/i}不是 100%% 自在的事情。你就不能忍一忍，听我把话说完吗？

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire15
: Yeah, sorry. That just...took me by surprise.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉。只是……太出乎我意料了。

lines.en: : You’re still seeing her outside of school, right? Because the last thing she said to me was actually {i}during{/i} the Dorm Wars and it was about going to look for {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你在校外还见她，对吧？因为她最后一次跟我说话，其实就是{i}在{/i}宿舍大战的时候，说的是要去找{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : She bailed on the whole competition to do that. And while {i}that{/i} part of her isn’t something I’d call unusual...everything else kind of has been.
lines.zh: : 她为了去找你，直接放弃了整场比赛。虽说她{i}那{/i}一点我倒不觉得反常……可其他的一切都很反常。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire16
: Maya and I...haven’t made as much progress as I would have liked since I transferred in. But we at least made {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: : 自我转学过来以后，Maya 和我……取得的进展并没有我希望的那么多。但我们至少做出了{i}一点东西{/i}。

lines.en: : Things changed a little bit. That...one-sided resentment she has for me never faded, but I could feel her starting to, like...I don’t know...resign herself maybe?
lines.zh: : 情况稍微有了点变化。她对我那种……单方面的怨恨从来没有消退过，但我能感觉到她开始……怎么说呢……认命了？

lines.en: : Kind of like a...“you stay on your side of the line and I’ll stay on mine” type of situation, but...
lines.zh: : 有点像是那种……「你待你那边，我待我这边」的局面，可是……

lines.en: : I mean, I guess {i}that{/i} isn’t entirely accurate either since that’s why she still hates me in the first place. I think. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我想{i}那{/i}也不完全准确，因为那本来就是她至今还恨我的原因。我想。我也不知道。

lines.en: : She’s always hated me and I’ve never really understood {i}why.{/i} But the point is that I felt like her hatred was starting to fade and...
lines.zh: : 她一直都恨我，而我从来没真正搞懂{i}为什么{/i}。但重点是，我感觉她的恨意开始淡了，然后……

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire17
: Out of nowhere, it’s gone right back to how it was when I first transferred in.
lines.zh: : 突然之间，它又完全变回了我刚转学来时的样子。

lines.en: : So I was wondering if you’ve {i}also{/i} noticed anything or...if I really am just going crazy.
lines.zh: : 所以我想知道，你是不是{i}也{/i}注意到了什么……或者我真的只是在发疯。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire18
: She {i}is{/i} different...
lines.zh: : 她{i}确实{/i}不一样了……

lines.en: : Right?! I fucking knew it! But everyone I’ve tried talking to about it has been all like, “Really? She seems the same to me.” And I’m just over here like ppfhfbfbfhfbttt?!?!! Are you BLIND?!
lines.zh: : 对吧？！我他妈就知道！可我试着跟每个人提起，他们的反应都是「真的吗？我看她没变啊」。而我在这边简直就是噗噗噗噗噗?!?!!你们瞎了吗？！

lines.en: : Talk to Ayane...she’ll agree with you...
lines.zh: : 去问问 Ayane……她会同意你的……

lines.en: : She’s noticed it too, then? Well, what is it? If you can tell me, I mean. If it’s something personal, I probably shouldn’t pry. It was just weird to me that she started being so...well, {i}weird{/i} all of a sudden and-
lines.zh: : 那她也注意到了？那到底是什么？我是说，如果你能告诉我的话。如果是私事，我大概不该追问。只是我觉得很奇怪，她突然变得那么……嗯，那么{i}怪{/i}，然后——

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire19
: Noriko, I...
lines.zh: : Noriko，我……

lines.en: : I don’t know how to talk to you about this.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该怎么跟你谈这件事。

lines.en: : And it’s probably going to make me sound insane, but I’m beginning to wonder if I {i}am{/i} insane and so...maybe that’s not really the worst thing possible.
lines.zh: : 说出来大概会让我听起来像疯了，但我已经开始怀疑自己是不是{i}真的{/i}疯了，所以……也许那也不算最糟的可能。

lines.en: : Tell me anything you’re comfortable with and not a word more. I’m not trying to play detective here, I just want an idea of what’s going on so I know how to approach her.
lines.zh: : 把你愿意说的告诉我，一个字都别多说。我不是想当侦探，我只是想知道大概发生了什么，好让我知道该怎么去面对她。

lines.en: : Noriko...that person I talked about when I came back to school...the one I lost...
lines.zh: : Noriko……我回到学校时提过的那个人……我失去的那个人……

lines.en: : I was talking about {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我说的是{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire20
: I {i}do{/i} still see her outside of school sometimes, but it’s more like I’m seeing her reflection. Or someone walking around in her skin while the {i}real{/i} her is just...gone.
lines.zh: : 我在校外有时{i}确实{/i}还会见到她，但那更像是看到了她的倒影。或者说是有人披着她的皮在四处走动，而{i}真正{/i}的她已经……不在了。

lines.en: : Like everything we've seen and felt together over the last few years is just...
lines.zh: : 就好像我们这几年一起看过、一起感受过的一切，都只是……

lines.en: : It's just...not {i}her...{/i}
lines.zh: : 都只是……不是{i}她{/i}了……

lines.en: : Is this...
lines.zh: : 这是不是……

lines.en: : Is this anything like that memory thing that happened to {i}you?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 是不是有点像{i}你{/i}身上发生过的那个记忆的事？……

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire21

: It’s {i}exactly{/i} like that. The same thing that happened to me happened to her. But I’m not sure if I can word it any differently than that without causing your brain to start instinctively interrupting me and-
lines.zh: : 就跟那个{i}一模一样{/i}。发生在我身上的事，发生在了她身上。但我不确定自己还能不能换个说法，而不让你的大脑本能地开始打断我，而且——

lines.en: : But, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 可是，老师……

lines.en: : If it’s the same thing that happened to you, doesn’t that mean she’s still in there somewhere?
lines.zh: : 如果那跟你身上发生的事一样，不就意味着她还在那副身体里的某个地方吗？

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire22
: Like...I don’t really get how it works, but you’re getting your memories back little by little, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 就是……我不太懂这是怎么回事，可你的记忆不是在一点点恢复吗？

lines.en: : Well...yeah...
: But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire23
: No...No, it’s {i}not{/i} the same thing that happened to me then...
lines.zh: : 不……不，那跟发生在我身上的事并{i}不{/i}一样……

lines.en: : But how do you know that?
lines.zh: : 可你怎么知道？

lines.en: : It’s not like you can read her mind, can you? And, if you can, could you maybe let me know why she refuses to be my friend when everyone around her is just as guilty of loving you as I am?
lines.zh: : 你又不能读她的心，对吧？如果你能的话，能不能顺便告诉我，为什么她周围的人跟我一样都犯了爱上你的罪，而她偏偏就是不肯跟我做朋友？

lines.en: : If that’s...
lines.zh: : 如果真是……

lines.en: : If that’s really how it is...
lines.zh: : 如果事情真的是这样……

lines.en: : If that’s really how it is, you’ll finally get to experience what Nee-chan and I have been going through these last...
lines.zh: : 如果事情真的是这样，那你终于也能尝尝姐和我这些年来一直在经历的滋味了……

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire24
: Last few...
lines.zh: : 这几……

lines.en: : Years?...
scene norikokonbinifire25
: A...Anyway! I know just how scary the thought of someone losing precious memories can be, but I also know now that it’s possible to get them back!
lines.zh: : 那……总之！我很清楚，想到有人会失去珍贵的记忆有多可怕，但我现在也知道，那些记忆是有可能找回来的！

lines.en: scene norikokonbinifire26
: And that’s an adventure all on its own.
lines.zh: : 而那本身就是一场冒险。

lines.en: : It might be hard...and the road might be bumpy...
lines.zh: : 也许会很艰难……也许路会颠簸……

lines.en: : But the scenery when you get there, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 但等你到了那里，看到的风景，老师？……

lines.en: scene black
: You’ll see such beautiful things...
lines.zh: : 你会看见那么美的东西……

lines.en: Noriko’s break comes to an end a few minutes later and she heads back inside to take over for Yumi.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，Noriko 的休息结束了，她走回店里去接 Yumi 的班。

lines.en: But I stay out here.
lines.zh: 但我留在外面。

lines.en: I’m not sure if I can walk right now.
lines.zh: 我不确定自己现在还走不走得动。

lines.en: And I know that Noriko would be more than happy to stay {i}with{/i} me, but she knows me. So she knows I want to be alone.
lines.zh: 我知道 Noriko 会很乐意留下来{i}陪{/i}我，但她了解我。所以她知道我想一个人待着。

lines.en: But the worst part is that I didn’t even have it in me to thank her for giving me the first taste of hope I’ve had since {i}she{/i} vanished.
lines.zh: 但最糟的是，我连一句谢谢都说不出口——谢谢{i}她{/i}给了我在那个人消失之后的第一丝希望。

lines.en: Is it really possible that she’s actually in there?...
lines.zh: 她真的可能还在那里面吗？……

lines.en: And if so...how do I get her back?
lines.zh: 如果是的话……我该怎么把她带回来？

lines.en: Do I just do what {i}she{/i} did and...ignore her until she figures it out herself?
lines.zh: 我要不要就照{i}她{/i}当初的做法……无视她，直到她自己想明白？

lines.en: What happens if I break her again?...
lines.zh: 如果我再一次把她弄坏了呢？……

lines.en: Will I see the same things she saw when she broke me?...
lines.zh: 我也会看到她当初弄坏我时看到的那些东西吗？……

lines.en: I don’t know...
lines.zh: 我不知道……

lines.en: I have no idea...
lines.zh: 我完全不知道……

lines.en: $ norikospring1 = True
$ noriko_love += 1
{i}Noriko’s affection increases to [noriko_love], but you’re too busy thinking about another girl to care!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]，可你正忙着想别的女孩，根本没心思在意！{/i}

lines.en: {i}This always happens to her! You should take this moment as a sign to spend more time with her and then eventually have sex with her because she deserves it!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这种事总是发生在她身上！你该把这一刻当作一个信号，多花点时间陪她，然后最终和她做爱，因为这是她应得的！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Also, she is wrong! Do not have hope! Do not pass Go! Do not collect $200!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}还有，她是错的！别抱希望！别过起点！别领那两百块！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Go home, cum in a sock, then forget this ever happened!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}回家，射进袜子里，然后把这一切忘掉！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Goodnight!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}晚安！{/i}
